title: Fabulous introduction to Barcelona!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our bike tour of Barcelona! Leonardo was a fabulous guide- friendly, knowledgeable, and wonderful with our daughters. He gave us a lot of information about the history of the area. The majority of the ride was on bike paths, so we felt very safe. I highly recommend this to families or anyone wanting an insider view of Barcelona!
author: Kristinrahlfs

title: Barcelona Bike Tour
text: The bikes were super easy to ride and our guide was very pleasant and informative. We covered a lot of sites and that gave you a good insite to further exploring.
author: judybruinewoud

title: Absolutely Fantastic First-Timer's Tour of Barcelona!
text:
If you're looking for an engaging and insightful way to experience the magic of Barcelona, look no further than this bicycle tour! From the moment we set off, it was clear this was going to be a special experience, and it absolutely delivered.

Our guide, Leo (one of the partners, which speaks volumes!), was truly exceptional. His knowledge of Barcelona and Catalunya was impressive, spanning everything from the breathtaking architecture to the rich history and even the current political landscape. title: Nice!

author: maartjen2016

title: Nice impression to get to know Barcelona
text: A beautiful tour to get to know Barcelona. You can reach everything by bike well and safely. I was actually the only guest and yet she took a lot of time to show me everything and give me time to take a closer look at the places.
author: Dietrich A

title: Great tour!
text: Wonderful tour! Karolina was sweet and informative! Would definitely recommend! The ride was a great opportunity to get the lay of the land. Would definitely recommend the first day or two upon arriving in Barcelona.
author: carverp2019

title: Great experience!
text: Leo was awesome! The tour pace was chill and we learned a lot about Barcelona. He was very accommodating with our schedule and helped us take lots of great photos. Thank you!
author: Bryon_S

title: Recommended Experience!
text: Leonardo was an amazing guide. I would truly recommend this experience if you would like to see all the touristy sites in Barcelona in only one day!
author: anthonyvN8188VM

title: Great tour & Great Guide
text: It was smooth & easy. Saw lots of great sites. No entry, just ideas of where to go back to: la Sagrada Familia, Gothic quarter, Arc de triumph, water front (olympic area). Great overview and our guide Karolina was the BEST. Very patient & knowledgeable about Barcelona. Only negative was Viators meeting instructions need to be more specific/ sending us to a crowded square was not helpful. But I contacted Viator and sent a photo & Karolina found us!
author: parrisgk
